title: Photographing a ring like a pro in 8 steps
h1: Photographing a ring like a pro in 8 steps
metaTitle: Photographing a ring like a pro in 8 steps
description: Discover 8 tips for shooting a ring by mastering the framing, lighting and background for exceptional visuals!
author: PackshotCreator
content:
Photographing a ring is a considerable challenge for professionals in the jewelry sector. Capturing every detail and reducing retouching time are daily challenges. Each piece of jewelry has unique characteristics that require special attention to reveal all its splendor. The light reflections, the brilliance of precious stones, and the finesse of the jewelry must be carefully highlighted to obtain perfect visuals.

But don't worry, Orbitvu has the solution! The Alphashot Micro Pro v2 photo studio now offers an innovative and unique technology to hold and photograph a ring with astonishing ease. With Orbitvu, you can guarantee exceptional results that will showcase the sheen and quality of your jewelry, captivating your customers and improving your online presence.

By following 8 simple and effective steps, you can capture photos, videos and 360° animations of your jewelry with the Orbitvu photography studio. This advanced equipment, controlled by software, will allow you to enhance every detail of your creations with unparalleled precision, while significantly reducing the time spent on post-production.

Alphashot Micro V2 video presentation

As shown in this demonstration video, the Alphashot Micro Version 2 is a device specially designed for photographing jewelry and luxury items. Here are its main features:

‍

‍

  • A cylindrical shape that creates a closed environment where everything can be controlled step by step
  • Adjustable camera position from horizontal to vertical, with a safety button
  • Integrated light panels individually controllable via the software in terms of intensity and light
  • Rotating platform at the base for creating presentations from a single angle, from multiple angles, in 360°, or even videos
  • The exclusive Brilliance Light function, which combines two different configurations:
    • A spotlight that focuses light on certain stones or diamonds
    • The LED Brilliance lights located above and below the camera

All of these features can be controlled 100% from the software to get the best rendering of your jewelry, especially pieces set with precious stones. The camera mount connects the camera directly to the system, ensuring exactly the same position for every shot.

The new design of the Alphashot Micro V2 features a USB Type-C port that makes it compatible with the latest mirrorless camera technology and allows for ultra-fast data transfer to the computer.

The combination of multiple light sources lets you photograph the same product with different contrasts thanks to the default presets built into the software. You can also create your own templates that best suit the type of product you're shooting.

Another feature of the Orbitvu Station software synchronized with the Alphashot Micro V2 is the glare management on the product photo. You can control the final appearance by choosing different backgrounds (black, white, or other) while maintaining professional highlights for the best result.

As our users confirm, the 100mm macro lens gives excellent results with this system, allowing you to capture every detail of your jewelry with exceptional sharpness.

1. Choosing the right lens to shoot a ring

In packshot photography, the choice of lens is crucial for getting professional-quality shots. Lens selection should be done carefully to ensure perfect images. A macro lens is perfect for photographing a ring or precious stones. It offers a 1:1 magnification ratio without additional accessories, while preserving the sharpness and detail of products. With a macro lens, you can capture the smallest details and create exceptional packshots.

‍

‍

That is why we recommend the Canon 100mm macro lens, ideal for photographing a ring thanks to its sharpness and its ability to capture breathtaking details up close. This lens will bring out the smallest details of your rings, highlighting the quality and craftsmanship of your creations. However, it is important to note that the blur effect caused by a shallow depth of field is unavoidable with a macro lens. Although this effect is generally sought after and appreciated by photographers, it can make the macro lens unsuitable for certain uses. If not, you can always use the Superfocus function, included in the Alphashot Micro Pro v2 software, to eliminate any progressive blur.

2. Use the transparent tray to photograph a ring and improve the appearance of the jewelry

The Orbitvu transparent tray is an essential tool for photographing a ring. It offers a clean, distraction-free background, ideal for enhancing the appearance of rings and other precious pieces. Thanks to its smooth, uniform surface, the tray reduces unwanted reflections and highlights the fine details and sheen of the jewelry. In addition, this tray has a marked center point, crucial for aligning the ring perfectly with the axis of rotation, ensuring a uniform and professional presentation of each piece.

‍

To achieve perfect alignment, it is essential to position the ring precisely on this central point. Make sure the ring doesn't move and that it is securely fixed in place. This precision guarantees the consistency of your photos, especially when you're shooting multiple images from different angles. Using this device, you will be able to capture high-quality visuals that highlight the beauty and sheen of your creations.

3. Place the ring flat or standing with clear adhesive

Once your transparent tray is in place and your camera is ready, you can lay the ring flat or stand it up using a transparent adhesive. Unlike other solutions on the market, the Alphashot Micro V2 does not have an integrated system to hold the rings in a vertical position. This is why the transparent adhesive technique is particularly important. Make sure the lighting is properly adjusted to avoid unwanted shadows. This adhesive can then be easily removed with the retouching tools in the software, ensuring that your images remain flawless. Remember to regularly check the alignment and focus to get the best possible results.

‍

‍

4. Position the adjustable spots to shoot a ring, add shine and soften the light with diffusers

The Orbitvu studio is equipped with adjustable spotlights, perfect for adding brilliance and highlighting the natural shine of precious stones. These spotlights are highly precise, allowing photographers and creators to control the lighting meticulously with the built-in software. The intensity of the spotlight can be adjusted from 1 to 100%, depending on the desired effect, and diffusers can be used to soften the light and avoid hard shadows. In addition, adjusting the spotlights with their articulated arms offers additional flexibility to illuminate every facet and reflection of the precious stones, ensuring photos of exceptional quality.

‍

‍

5. Use silver and black reflectors to manipulate light and shadows

Creating adequate contrast is crucial in jewelry photography. Using silver and black reflectors lets you control the light and shadows around the ring, highlighting its distinctive features such as gemstone inlays and fine details. These reflectors also optimize the color rendering and textures of your jewelry, enhancing each piece with refinement.

‍

‍

For example, to photograph a diamond ring, use the silver reflector to create bright flashes that can give an impressive sparkling effect. You can also emphasize the facets of the diamond and capture plays of light that enhance the elegance of the piece. This highlights the brilliance and purity of the precious stones under different lighting conditions. On the other hand, to photograph a ring with darker tones or in matte metal, use a black reflector to accentuate the shadows, which can add depth and mystery to the final image. This creates striking contrasts that highlight the subtle details of the materials, while adding a dramatic touch to the whole composition.

6. Adapt the lighting for particular stones such as amber

For a product photographer, whether amateur or professional, light is the main tool after the camera. The goal is to produce a series of photos that are consistent and true to life. In ring photography, certain stones, such as amber, may react badly to intense lighting. It is therefore essential to adapt your approach. Avoid lamps that could mask the natural beauty of the stones and experiment with different lighting settings, via the software, to find the most flattering configuration.

‍

‍

When mastered, light enhances the colors, reveals the details, the glints and the sheen of the stone. The Alphashot Micro Pro v2 is equipped with an exclusive cylindrical lighting system around the objects. Thanks to its removable LED-backlit side doors, you can let your creativity run free while enjoying more subtle lighting. In addition, the software integrated into the Orbitvu photo studio allows you to save your light settings using predefined templates, guaranteeing perfect consistency in all of your jewelry photos. Such a system offers the lighting accuracy essential for photographing a ring and reproducing the sumptuous effect of a jeweler's display window. It also allows virtual interaction with your prospect.

7. Use the software for post-production and adjust the colors of silver or gold jewelry

The built-in software speeds up the post-production of your content with a wide range of tools and features. In particular, it lets you selectively adjust the colors of your jewelry, whatever their material or hue. Photographing a silver or gold ring requires particular attention to color fidelity. As mentioned earlier, it is essential to use appropriate lighting to avoid hard shadows and unwanted reflections. Opt for a neutral background to showcase the pieces and bring out their natural shine.

‍

‍

In addition, use the retouching software integrated into the Orbitvu photo studio. Adjust the gray and yellow tones by working on the gray tolerance, saturation and luminosity. This ensures that the true colors of the jewelry appear sharp and vibrant without picking up the surrounding reflections. Also take the time to refine the contrasts and balance the light levels. This will allow you to get an image that best reflects the beauty and quality of the photographed jewelry. Don't forget to refine the details and correct small imperfections to get a flawless final result!

8. Use a black tray setup and a black reflector for striking images

The little magic touch of successful jewelry photography lies in the use of interchangeable trays. Whether white, black or glass, a tray allows you to present your products as you wish. Depending on the type of jewelry and the desired atmosphere, you can play with reflections and contrasts. This allows you to highlight the details and materials of your jewelry. Indeed, with this technique, you will be able to create unique and captivating photos that will catch the eye of customers.

‍

‍

Our black table and black reflector setup enhances your jewelry. It highlights its sheen and details. Perfect for captivating and professional images, it gives your jewelry an elegant appeal. With this setup, capture every facet and reflection of your jewelry to seduce your customers. Contact us to find out more!

Conclusion

Thanks to these 8 steps and the Alphashot Micro Pro v2, photographing a ring like a professional is possible. Each step optimizes your workflow for exceptional and consistent results. These tips improve the quality of your photographs and showcase your jewelry in a professional way. Indeed, these techniques highlight every detail and accentuate the sheen of precious stones.

The precision and clarity of Orbitvu equipment bring out the beauty of each piece. This attracts customers' attention and increases your sales. You will gain in efficiency and each photo will accurately reflect the quality of your products. This is essential for building your customers' trust and satisfaction.

faqs.question: How can you maximize productivity with an automated studio?
faqs.answer: The Alphashot Micro Pro v2 can process up to 150 pieces of jewelry per day with 360° photos and detailed views. The built-in software automates post-production, including the removal of transparent supports and color adjustment. Predefined templates let you save settings by material type, ensuring perfect visual consistency across all collections.

faqs.question: How do you get perfect sharpness across the entire piece of jewelry?
faqs.answer: The Superfocus function integrated into the Orbitvu software automates focus stacking. Combined with an optimal aperture (f/16-f/22), this technology guarantees flawless sharpness on all facets of the jewelry, even the smallest details. The system also eliminates any progressive blur, a common problem in macro photography.

faqs.question: How can you effectively manage reflections on precious stones?
faqs.answer: The Alphashot Micro Pro v2 features an exclusive cylindrical LED lighting system with adjustable backlit side doors. This configuration lets you adapt the lighting precisely to the characteristics of each stone. The software offers specific presets for different materials (gold, diamond, sapphire, emerald, pearl, ruby), automatically optimizing the lighting for each type of jewelry.

faqs.question: How can you optimize visuals for e-commerce?
faqs.answer: The studio integrates preconfigured settings that meet the requirements of the main e-commerce platforms. The software automates the export of images in the required formats and dimensions, while managing the white balance to ensure faithful color reproduction. Visual consistency is maintained thanks to predefined templates, which are essential for a professional online presentation.

faqs.question: What is the return on investment for an automated photo studio?
faqs.answer: The ROI is optimized thanks to several factors: the complete automation of the shooting and post-production process, the significant reduction in processing time (up to 150 products per day), and the elimination of photo subcontracting costs. The system also allows visuals to be integrated directly into your e-commerce content management system, further reducing the time it takes to publish online.
